recipientAddress.description: YOUR Solana wallet address (base58) — where payments settle. Public key only; the skill never holds custody. Required.

priceUsdc.description: Default price per request in USDC. Default: 0.01.

network.description: Settlement network. Default: solana-mainnet. Set solana-devnet to test.

requireOnChain.description: Accept a payment only after its transaction is confirmed settled on Solana (revenue-grade). Default: true. Set false for a structural-only check.

dedupe.description: Reject a settled payment that has already been redeemed (single-use). Default: true. In-memory unless replayStorePath is set.

replayStorePath.description: File path for a restart-durable single-instance replay store. Omit for in-memory (per-process). For multi-instance, back replay with your own durable store and set dedupe=false.

requirePresenterAuth.description: Require the caller to sign the gate-issued nonce with the payer key, so an observer of the on-chain payment can't replay it for free access. Default: true. Needs an x402 client that signs the challenge nonce.

challengeSecret.description: Secret used to MAC presenter-auth nonces. Omit for an ephemeral per-process secret (single instance). Set a shared value to verify nonces across instances/restarts.

rpcUrl.description: Optional Solana RPC URL override for on-chain confirmation.
